verdict.rationale: The job-creation docs say the language parameter is optional: "If not provided, the language will be auto-detected for each speech segment." Developers can therefore skip declaring the language, and detection happens per segment rather than once per file. Declaring a language explicitly remains available through ISO 639-1 codes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of detection accuracy, and documentation of whether the detected language is returned in the output and which languages detection covers.
